summary: This joint resolution disapproves a Department of Energy rule setting certification, labeling, and enforcement requirements for energy conservation standards on certain consumer products and commercial equipment, nullifying the rule so it has no force or effect.

The bill disapproves a DOE rule (89 Fed. Reg. 81994) establishing certification, labeling, and enforcement for energy conservation standards on consumer products and commercial equipment. These standards promote energy efficiency, reducing energy consumption and associated emissions, which directly supports environmental protection and climate goals. By nullifying the rule via CRA, the bill prevents these regulations from taking effect, thereby limiting environmental regulations on appliances. This is the core and sole purpose of the bill, making it a strong push to limit such protections.
